name: Color Game! 🎨
desc:
🎨 Grow your color and become unstoppable 🎨

Welcome to Color Game! In this game, you can:

🖌️ Control and spread your color across the board!
🌈 Claim tiles and outsmart rivals to dominate the arena!
✨ Customize with unique trails, patterns, pets and effects!
🏆 Compete on leaderboards and prove your coloring skills!
🎭 Unlock rare skins and special power-ups as you play

Can you cover the most ground and become the color champion? 🚀
If you’re enjoying the game, give it a 👍
